title: Titanic Two-Ships — Unified ETL + Boosting + Calibration + Fairness

modules.dataset: Unified ETL for classic Titanic (Stanford mirror) + Spaceship Titanic (Kaggle; synthetic fallback for offline use). Normalizes both into a 14-feature unified schema.
modules.model: Three boosters (LightGBM, CatBoost, XGBoost) with sklearn Pipeline (imputer + OneHot + StandardScaler). Isotonic/Sigmoid calibration via CalibratedClassifierCV. Fairness slicing across sex/pclass/age/alone.
modules.tests: 12 tests: loaders, training, calibration math (perfect predictions → Brier=0), fairness slice math (verified on tiny hand-crafted example), CLI smoke test

entry_point: python train.py [--datasets classic spaceship] [--models catboost xgboost lightgbm] [--calibration isotonic] --metrics-json metrics.json
